column1: # Tagalog LOANWORD lexicon (SHIPPED override) — the FOREIGN-SEGMENT loanword class only: Spanish ⟨j⟩→[h]
# (abenojar→abenohaɾ) and soft ⟨c⟩→[s] (abece→abese). Origin-specific (native Tagalog has neither), so pinning
# never touches native words. Built by applying the foreign op to our OWN shipped output (inherits our stress +
# final-ʔ) and keeping it only where all wikipron readings agree AND the op matches the referee. The broader VV/
# glide/hiatus loanword class is NOT mined (same spelling = native [ij]/hiatus-ʔ vs loanword glide → would corrupt
# siya/tao). SHIPPED-only: phonemizeWordRules (the eval) skips it → non-circular.
